reports.title: Harmony Biosciences Reports Q3 Financial Results

lines: Reiterates Full Year Guidance of $1.0B to $1.04B

WAKIX® (pitolisant) delivered third quarter net revenue of $269 million, driven by strong demand of 400 net patient adds, and the Company remains on track to achieve full-year WAKIX net revenue guidance of $1.0 billion to $1.04 billion.
On Track to Achieve 2026 WAKIX Net Revenue Guidance of $1.0 Billion to $1.04 Billion
